plugin.name: Nothing Ear
plugin.description: Battery, ANC, EQ presets and low-latency mode for Nothing and CMF earbuds, controlled directly over Bluetooth.

device_mac.label: Earbuds MAC Address
device_mac.description: Leave empty to auto-detect or pick from the panel. Set it to pin one device.

show_in_bar.label: Show live status in bar
show_in_bar.description: Show the battery number next to the icon, updated in the background.

show_percentage.label: Show battery percentage in bar
show_percentage.description: Add a % sign after the battery number.

mono_on_single_bud.label: Auto mono when only one bud is out
mono_on_single_bud.description: Switch to mono while one bud is in its closed case, so you hear everything in the other.

panel.title: Nothing Ear

latency.title: Low Latency Mode
latency.caption: Less delay for games and video

mono.title: Mono Audio
mono.caption: Same sound in both buds. Auto mode is in settings
mono.caption_auto: Turns on by itself when one bud is out
mono.caption_auto_active: On because only one bud is out

panel.guidance: Pick your earbuds below, or set the Bluetooth MAC address manually in this plugin's settings.

devices.title: Paired Bluetooth Devices
devices.none: No paired Bluetooth devices found. Make sure the earbuds are paired at the OS level, then scan again.

notify.mono_on_body: Only one earbud is out, so both channels play in it.
notify.mono_off_body: Both earbuds are out or back in the case.
